text:
Eligibility and Cost Sharing

Inclusion of voluntary committed cost sharing is prohibited.

Limit on Number of Proposals per Organization:

There are no restrictions or limits.

Limit on Number of Proposals per PI or co-PI: 1

An individual may participate as PI or co-PI on a maximum of one proposal submitted to this solicitation in a single fiscal year. The submitting organization is responsible for ensuring this limit is met.

annotations.rationale: The explicit no-limit field applies to the organization, independently of PI rules.
Prohibited voluntary committed cost sharing is not a mandatory contribution.
A PI limit must never become an institutional limit.
